links.plain: spatial map spotting the wall and doorway frame shift
links.function: registers the geometric transition from one enclosed room layout into a new space
links.narration_bridge: Detects cortical scene-structure shifts at boundaries in Baldassano et al. (2017, Neuron, SRC2).

links.plain: memory hub firing boundary cells to archive the old room chapter
links.function: triggers a rapid boundary-cell pulse that files the finished room episode into long-term memory
links.narration_bridge: Directly recorded in human hippocampal boundary neurons by Zheng et al. (2022, Nature Neuroscience, SRC3).

links.plain: front working-memory desk flushing the old errand on the threshold
links.function: clears prior-room working-memory items to free capacity for the new room, dropping overloaded errands
links.narration_bridge: Explains Radvansky et al.'s (2011, SRC1) 28% vs 23% doorway error spike and McFadyen et al.'s (2021, SRC5) load interaction.
